import { Aside, Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

This template names legal documents by matter number, document date, type, and party — so a sorted folder reads as the chronology of the engagement. It handles court-stamped filings, counterparty drafts, and the scanner's `Scan_0042.pdf` alike.

## Naming pattern

```
{Matter Number} – {Detected Date} – {Document Type} – {Party}
```

| Block | Source | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Matter Number | Custom AI Block extracting your client-matter number as formatted in your system | `2026-0142` |
| Detected Date | The document's own date — execution, filing stamp, or letter date | `2026-06-11` |
| Document Type | AI-detected type from your vocabulary | `NDA` |
| Party | The counterparty, court, or correspondent | `Vertex GmbH` |

Version markers (`v01`, `executed`, `as-filed`) are best managed at draft time; the template's job is intake — naming what arrives.

## Before and after

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| `Document(1).pdf` | `2026-0142 – 2026-05-29 – Answer – Meridian LLC.pdf` |
| `Scan_0042.pdf` | `2026-0142 – 2026-03-02 – Engagement Letter – Vertex GmbH.pdf` |
| `Agreement (clean).docx` | `2026-0142 – 2026-06-11 – Settlement Agreement – Meridian LLC.docx` |

## Build it

<Steps>
1. Choose your confidentiality posture first: [Offline AI mode](/docs/offline-ai) keeps analysis fully local; [BYOK](/docs/byok) routes it through the firm's own provider account.
2. Create a Template named "Legal Intake".
3. Add a [Custom AI Block](/docs/custom-ai-blocks) for the matter number: "the matter or case number, formatted YYYY-NNNN; leave empty if absent".
4. Add **Detected Date** (`YYYY-MM-DD`), a Custom AI Block for document type ("Complaint, Answer, Motion, Order, NDA, MSA, Engagement Letter, Correspondence, Memo, Exhibit"), and one for the party.
5. Test on a copied batch of mixed intake — a filing, a draft from counsel, a scan — and review the preview.
6. Assign the Template to [folder monitoring](/docs/folder-monitoring) on the e-filing download folder and the scanner output folder.
</Steps>

<Aside type="tip">
Keep privileged descriptions out of the pattern — type and party identify a document without disclosing substance in directory listings and attachment lines.
</Aside>
